name: FitCalc – BMI Calculator
author: Adnan Shahid

sections.description:
FitCalc is a lightweight and responsive Body Mass Index (BMI) calculator plugin for WordPress websites.
It allows visitors to quickly calculate their BMI using either Metric (cm/kg) or Imperial (ft/lbs) units.
The plugin instantly displays the BMI value along with its classification (e.g., underweight, normal, overweight, obese).

Features:
* Simple shortcode [fitcalc_bmi]
* Supports Metric and Imperial units
* Responsive design
* Quick BMI classification
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fitcalc directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [fitcalc_bmi] to any post or page where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I display the calculator?

Use the shortcode [fitcalc_bmi] inside any post or page.

Does it support both metric and imperial?

Yes, users can switch between metric (cm/kg) and imperial (ft/lbs).
